instructions: Given several examples from a dataset please write observations about trends that hold for most or all of the samples. I will also provide you with a few observations I have already made.  Please add your own observations or if you feel the observations are comprehensive say 'COMPLETE' Some areas you may consider in your observations: topics, content, syntax, conciceness, etc. It will be useful to make an educated guess as to the nature of the task this dataset will enable. Don't be afraid to be creative
